subject: Where pricing landed
opener: Thanks for the time today. Here is where pricing landed.

bullets.text: Our quote is twenty eight per month for all five locations, with routing, texting and recall tooling included.
RingHawk counter-offered twenty two to keep the account the moment it sensed a switch.
You flagged the six-per-seat gap that Dr. Mehta will question.
You asked for fifteen off, enough to make this a service decision.
I will come back with a sharper number and the porting proof, and you will take it to Dr. Mehta.

close: Every line above came from something said on the call. If I got any of it wrong, tell me and I will fix it.
